notes:
Balance book 0.4.0 adds permanent deletion, per-transaction Update Sent tracking, one consolidated pending update, and editable WhatsApp templates with tap-to-insert placeholders.

- Removes old deleted records when upgrading or restoring. Already-sent transactions are protected by default; Settings > Transactions can allow deletion. Deleting removes saved messages containing the transaction and adds no correction line.
- Collects every unsent transaction in date order, preserving original entry order for same-day items. Sent items are excluded; editing an entry makes it pending again.
- Uses compact rounding arrows beside the portion; whole-dollar amounts hide the arrows. Messages show only the selected portion.
- Formats expenses on one line, with portion, description, date, and total. Customize reusable templates in Settings > Message formatting, or edit an individual draft before copying.
- Preserves unsaved-change warnings and icon-only Cancel / Save controls.

Install over your existing copy. Do not uninstall or clear app data. Source remains private; new installations start with an empty ledger.

Validation includes domain/migration tests, phone-sized browser flows, Android unit tests, release lint, and signature verification. Google sign-in, notification delivery, WhatsApp reply selection, and installation on a physical phone are not claimed as tested for this release.
